test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Devanampriya Piyadasi is another name for whom among the following Mauryan kings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashoka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Devanampriya Piyadasi** is another name for **Emperor Ashoka** of the Mauryan Dynasty.
 
• Ashoka is one of India's greatest emperors, known for his significant contributions to the spread of Buddhism.
 
• He ruled almost the entire Indian subcontinent from c. 2
